items.quote: God also made the people of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.
items.contrast: The people of Shechem are the people punished by the curse, whereas the seventy brothers were Abimelek’s victims.
items.reason: The plural pronoun “them” refers to the immediately preceding “people of Shechem,” so the key is fully supported. Understanding the answer requires resolving that reference rather than mistaking the murdered brothers for those on whom the curse came.
